title: Los Tres Dineros
description: A vanilla-plus Minecraft modpack that enhances survival with way deeper exploration, immersion, and building while preserving the core vanilla experience.
body:
![The image is a cinematic Minecraft-style promotional scene for “LOS TRES DINEROS.”  It shows a huge, detailed blocky landscape at sunset with mountains, rivers, forests, and a village spread across the valley. On the left foreground, a Minecraft character wearing a green cloak stands on a cliff next to a wolf with a green collar, both looking out over the world.  In the center, the title LOS TRES DINEROS is displayed in big, bold pixel-style lettering:  “LOS TRES” is styled in bright white and gold tones “DINEROS” is styled in bright green block letters with a Minecraft feel The design includes a coin-like icon above the title, reinforcing the theme  At the bottom, small icons represent gameplay themes like exploration, building, discovery, and survival, giving it a modpack “feature showcase” feel.  Overall, it looks like a high-energy Minecraft modpack cover meant to feel adventurous, rich, and inviting.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3c2d5405542e6ea4b507eb191c3dfc772ca6ae0c_0.webp)


you load into **Los Tres Dineros** and it already feels a bit different — same Minecraft, but the world doesn’t feel empty anymore. it’s like the game actually wants you to go outside and explore instead of just staying near your spawn mining forever.

as you play, you start noticing there’s always something going on. weird structures in the distance, better places to explore, and a world that feels way more alive and less predictable. building also becomes way more fun since you’ve got more freedom to make your base look cool without it feeling complicated or “modded out” too much. everything still feels like Minecraft, just turned up a notch.

by the time you’ve played for a while, it basically turns into this constant adventure where you’re always thinking “okay what’s over there?” instead of just sticking to the same routine. **Los Tres Dineros** keeps the vanilla vibe but makes survival feel bigger, funnier, and way more exciting every time you log in.
